vip.finding: Nothing in this repository is a VIP Tracker feed, schema, client or import.
worthBringing: Opportunity status and the last time that status changed
A link from a VIP record to a counterparty already on the Market Screen
The region, so the Monday list and the Analysis Dashboard can use the same names
pipeline: A documented VIP export or API has to be supplied first. None is in this repo, so no address is guessed here.
A scheduled job would fetch that source and refuse the run if the payload has no source timestamp.
The job would write one JSON file whose updated field is that source timestamp, then this page would read only that file.
Until that file exists, this page shows no VIP rows.
vip.staleRisk: If a feed is connected later and the job stops, or if someone pastes a partial extract, the rows would go out of date while still looking current. Every dataset on this page shows its last-updated date so a stale file is visible. An incomplete VIP link must not be read as a live tracker.
